content.title: San Antonio Spurs vs Memphis Grizzlies Live Stream: How To Watch NBA
content.text: Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs go for a seventh straight win against the Memphis Grizzlies. Since the All-Star Break, the San Antonio Spurs (54-18) have been one of the best teams in the NBA. San Antonio is 16-2, with 12 wins against playoff teams. Victor Wembanyama is playing his way into the MVP conversation, carrying San Antonio to the second-best record in the NBA. With just 10 games left in the regular season, San Antonio is just 3.0 games behind the Oklahoma City Thunder for the best record in the Western Conference and the NBA. They close out the regular season series against the Memphis Grizzlies (24-47), who have lost 11 of their last 12 games and 31 of the last 40 games overall. Memphis did win in the last meeting between the teams, 106-105, back in January. Wembanyama came off the bench in that loss for 30 points, five rebounds, and three assists on 10-20 shooting. This season, Wembanyama has taken a unique path to MVP candidacy, starting 48 games and coming off the bench for nine. This season, Wembanyama is averaging 24.3 points, 11.2 rebounds, 3.0 blocks, and 3.0 assists per game on 50-35-82 shooting splits. He is also only playing 29.2 minutes per game with a 31.9% usage rate and 28.4 PER. In the history of the NBA, no player has won the MVP playing less than 30.0 minutes per game.
